title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: In 4-fold cross-validation, the data is divided into $$4$$ parts. Each part is used once as a validation set while the other $$3$$ parts are used for training.

title: Regularization Parameter
text: Jessica is considering $$5$$ different values for the regularization parameter \(\lambda\).

title: Calculating Validation Errors
text: For each value of \(\lambda\), $$4$$ validation errors are calculated (one for each fold).

title: Total Validation Errors
text: Multiply the number of \(\lambda\) values by the number of folds to find the total number of validation errors.
